items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of electric wheelchair
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Entscheidung innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse, Versichertenplatz 3, 20097 Musterhafen.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 20 Nov 2026. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a letter sent by ordinary post counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Tue 24 Nov 2026 (no weekend/holiday shift for this deemed-delivery step). The one-month Widerspruch period starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X) and ends one month later on the day with the same number, Thu 24 Dec 2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). Thu 24 Dec 2026 is a working day in NW (Christmas Eve itself is not a statutory public holiday in NW, though many offices close early), so no further shift applies under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X. To allow for postal transit, send the Widerspruch by Fri 18 Dec 2026 at the latest.

warnings: 24 December 2026 is Christmas Eve; while it is not a statutory public holiday, post and the insurer's office may not be reachable, so sending the Widerspruch well before the deadline (by 18 Dec 2026) is strongly advised.
